articles.title: Fabrinet: A Compelling AI Infrastructure Opportunity
articles.text: Fabrinet is a critical supplier to the AI and data center ecosystem, yet its stock has lagged AI peers, up just 0.7% YTD. I see recent multiple compression as unwarranted; FN's robust ROIC (mid-30s to low-40s) and sequential growth in optical communications support a Buy rating. Modeling a Q4 revenue beat ($1.31B vs. Street $1.27B) and adjusted EPS of $4.02, I expect a strong report and positive outlook for FY27.
